title: Dynamics of nucleation in thermal phase transitions
summary: We study dynamical effects during nucleation in thermal first-order phase transitions in field theory. Focusing on the classical regime of the decay of a metastable state, we present the general formula for the thermal decay rate including the dynamical prefactor and give a recipe for its systematic evaluation. We describe the physical mechanism which reduces the actual thermal decay rate with respect to the statistical rate obtained in equilibrium theory.
